paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of two methods – “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours)” – across four datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, listed in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each dataset, two bars are displayed side-by-side representing each method; “Vanilla CoT” is represented by a pale yellow bar, and “TLDR (Ours)” is represented by a forest green bar. In GSM8K, the “Vanilla CoT” bar reaches approximately 89.4% accuracy, while the “TLDR (Ours)” bar extends to 86.8% accuracy. For MATH500, the “Vanilla CoT” bar extends to approximately 42.9% accuracy, while the “TLDR (Ours)” bar reaches 81.5% accuracy. In AIME, "Vanilla CoT" reaches approximately 86.8% accuracy and "TLDR (Ours)" reaches 89.4%. Finally, in AMC, the “Vanilla CoT” bar reaches approximately 81.5% accuracy, and the “TLDR (Ours)” bar extends to approximately 86.8% accuracy. Each bar is annotated with a percentage change relative to the other method within that dataset. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation beyond the percentage change labels.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours)”, across four datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents accuracy values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks every 20 units. For each dataset, there are two bars displayed side-by-side, with “Vanilla CoT” represented by a light yellow color and “TLDR (Ours)” represented by a dark green color. In the GSM8K dataset, the “Vanilla CoT” bar reaches approximately 89.4% accuracy, while the “TLDR (Ours)” bar extends to approximately 86.8% accuracy. The MATH500 dataset shows bars reaching approximately 42.9% and 81.5% for “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours)” respectively. For AIME, the “Vanilla CoT” bar reaches around 1.7% accuracy, and the “TLDR (Ours)” bar extends to 89.4%. Finally, for AMC, the bar heights are approximately 81.5% for “Vanilla CoT” and 86.8% for “TLDR (Ours)”.  Above each bar, percentage changes in accuracy relative to the “Vanilla CoT” method are indicated, ranging from -1.7% to +1.6%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
